versos.texto_bv: A vasilha de barro em que o homem com fluxo tocar será quebrada, e todo utensílio de madeira será enxaguado com água.
versos.traducao_literal: E um utensílio de barro em que tocar o que tem fluxo será quebrado, e todo utensílio de madeira será enxaguado na água.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Conversão de passivas para ativa exigiria especificar agente (quem quebra? quem enxagua?) não presente no original hebraico, que emprega passiva impessoal típica de texto prescritivo. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'será quebrado... será enxaguado' — sem sujeito agente explícito; adição de sujeito (3ª pessoa plural indeterminada ou 2ª pessoa) alteraria sentido ao introduzir agente não codificado.

kjv.texto: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

vizinhos.11: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
vizinhos.13: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

web.texto: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

vizinhos.11: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
vizinhos.13: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
